entry_points.text: Fair wakeup placement selects a destination from previous CPU, wake flags and topology: it records wakees, fast-returns on current CPU, tries an energy-aware choice when the root domain is not overutilized, evaluates affine candidacy, walks domains for affine and balance flags, then uses a slow balance path on domain match or an idle-sibling choice on the wakeup path.

Load-balance soft interrupt first attempts tickless balancing for stopped-tick idle CPUs and returns if such work was pending, else refreshes local blocked averages and balances domains. The main idle path handles offline termination and deferred tickless updates, loops sleeping with flushes and poll or cpuidle selection, then propagates reschedule, exits tickless handling, clears polling, orders memory, flushes inter-processor work and schedules.

Forced precise idle validates FIFO policy with single-CPU affinity, kernel-thread context without memory management or affinity change, and non-zero duration, then disables preemption, marks idle, picks deep idle from latency, arms a pinned monotonic timer, idles until completion and restores state with folded reschedule. Boot entry marks the task idle, prepares architecture idle, signals online idle and loops in the idle handler.

Housekeeping early init returns when no flags are set, else enables the override key, initializes tick offload for kernel-noise isolation and reallocates boot-time masks to heap with deferred release. Late init drains the boot-time mask list and releases each block.

Entering nohz load mode folds any pending per-runqueue delta into shared accumulation. Periodic global update returns inside the sample window, else folds the drained nohz delta into the active count, refreshes the three averages, advances the window one interval and catches up missed intervals.

exports.text: Tickless idle entry and deferred work handler. Entry records blocked load and stopped tick, joins idle set and publishes domain idle state; offline and fully isolated CPUs skip joining. Handler clears the new-balance kick and refreshes stopped-tick stats only when sole reason and no reschedule pending.

Idle state association, polling force control and cpuidle region test. Setter stores current low-power state or discards when disabled; poll counter is refcounted with underflow warning and boot options force on or off; predicate tests a PC inside cpuidle text.

Weak architecture idle hooks with generic defaults. Prepare, enter, exit, terminal offline sleep and default sleep are overridable; terminal sleep never returns, generic sleep forces polling, and the generic routine wraps sleep with polling, broadcast, tracing and timing.

Housekeeping affinity helpers. One constrains affinity to the type mask only when isolation is enabled and that type is flagged; membership test passes when disabled or not isolated, otherwise tests the CPU against the type mask.
Load average accessor returns the three averages each plus a caller offset and then shifted by a caller shift.
Membarrier context helpers. Exec orders prior accesses then clears barrier state and syncs the runqueue copy; context switch loads the next context state and updates the runqueue copy only on change.

hazards.text: Active balancing has a queue-to-execution window where CPUs may go inactive, so liveness is rechecked under lock before moving a task; a same-queue source and target is treated as impossible and warned about.

Tickless entry on a foreign CPU, poll-counter underflow, attaching or selecting a still-delayed entity, taking an offline CPU with pending reschedule, and leaving cpuidle with interrupts disabled are one-time warnings with defined recovery such as enabling interrupts.

If the local CPU gains work mid-scan and needs rescheduling, the tickless scan aborts and re-arms global indicators for the next owner. Cpuidle helpers recheck polling after clearing it and abort entry with busy status on wakeup arrival, avoiding lost wakeups and stale residency.

Idle entry publishes the idle mask before global indicators so a scanner missing the mask observes the indicators; the scanner clears flags before scanning. Idle exit clears polling before processing wakeups and keeps interrupts disabled until the sleep instruction or equivalent rollback protection.

Idle-class load balancing is unexpected and warns once. Removing an idle task emits a diagnostic with stack trace while dropping and reacquiring the runqueue lock. Switching to idle via the generic path is fatal, and idle priority change is fatal unless old and new priorities match.

Load-balance flag bits are all-pinned 1, need-break 2, destination-pinned 4, some-pinned 8, active-balance 16, LLC-pinned 32 and active-LLC-balance 64. Maximum pinned interval is 512, default maximum balance interval is one tenth of a second, and the balancing-runner count is an atomic starting at zero.

Assumed minimum runnable count for force-idle slice judgement is two. Nanosecond-to-tick conversion divides by nanoseconds per second over tick rate. The tickless scan seeds next balance at now plus sixty seconds. Housekeeping flags are single-bit positions from domain-boot, domain, managed-IRQ and kernel-noise type ids. The membarrier command mask aggregates global, global-expedited, private-expedited, sync-core and rseq variants when enabled, plus get-registrations.

invariants.text: Energy target replacement prefers strictly greater fit, then smaller delta when both usable, then larger actual capacity when both unusable. Perf span either exposes the energy-model CPU set or null for absent model; callers handle null.

Cross-runqueue migration detaches load average unless already migrating, compensates lag, clears the update stamp and refreshes NUMA scan; exit only detaches. Max allowed capacity is inactive unless asymmetric is enabled, else the first RCU entry intersecting affinity, refreshed on fair affinity change.

Fair wakeup preemption needs distinct unthrottled entities, feature gates and no pending reschedule; it prefers non-idle, refreshes current, excludes non-normal, delayed and fork wakeups, allows a short override, nominates a buddy and manages slice protection. Sync variant needs deadline order and elapsed runtime past migration cost, reduced when stacked, with negative elapsed clamped.

Priority change on non-queued, unchanged or single-task queues is a no-op; running tasks with numerically increased priority reschedule, queued non-running tasks check preemption. Throttle state follows the group hierarchy, fork only records max capacity, and round-robin interval is zero on idle queues else derived from slice converted to ticks.

Putting previous fair task walks the entity hierarchy unless next shares the group, clears root current with a warning on mismatch, and requeues when still on runqueue. Yield is a no-op with one runnable task, else clears buddies, updates clock and stats, forfeits virtual time when eligible; yield-to needs a queued non-delayed target nominated as next buddy.

Active balancing runs as a stopper on the busiest CPU, rejecting inactive or wrong CPUs and cleared or single-runnable queues, finding a domain spanning both CPUs under RCU, detaching one task with active flags, resetting failure count on success and attaching on target; plain and LLC forms differ only by the LLC flag.

Periodic balancing walks domains under RCU, decays idle costs, stops when another group CPU balances more actively, balances expired domains, tracks earliest next balance and publishes the deadline when any domain was visited. Idle transition marks a shared LLC domain nohz-idle once and decrements busy count.

Blocked stats refresh only when the queue advertises blocked load, stays in the idle set and its interval elapsed. The tickless scan clears globals only when kick reasons present, orders before scanning from after the local CPU, optionally refreshes each idle CPU, balances on deadline, and publishes next balance only if some queue contributed.

Online fair runqueues refresh control and runtime; offline also exposes throttled groups and removes share. The fair tick walks queued entities updating levels and weights, reweights the leaf, and in non-queued context updates NUMA, cache, misfit, overutilization and core state. Slice exhaustion scales consumed runtime by task count; force-idle with one runnable exhausted entity reschedules. Group change of never-woken tasks is ignored, else detach, clear stamp, refresh CPU and attach.

Leaving fair detaches the entity, dequeuing delayed ones first; joining attaches, records capacity, warns if still delayed, and reschedules when running or checks preemption when queued. Selecting next clears buddies, installs hierarchy entities with runtime and throttle setup, publishes the leaf, reweights, protects first slice, refreshes MRU order, hrtick, misfit and tick-stop.

Cpuidle entry returns with interrupts enabled when reschedule is pending; without drivers it uses generic idle, suspend-to-idle or forced latency picks deepest allowed state with tick stopped, multi-state drivers consult the governor which may revise tick-stopping and reflect, single-state uses state zero. Polling spins with interrupts enabled while forced or broadcast-expired and no reschedule; tick stop follows request or prior stopped state; broadcast enter and exit are static-key gated or no-ops.

Idle class placement never migrates and wakeup always requests reschedule; accounting ignores non-positive deltas and forwards deltas to fair and deadline servers; core idle update runs only with SMT scheduling; idle tick only refreshes accounting. Idle PELT accumulates lost idle time when summed fair, rt and deadline utilization reaches a capacity threshold.

A static key records whether any housekeeping isolation is configured; tick offload init is a successful no-op here. Boot setup parses a CPU list, derives the housekeeping complement, keeps at least one present CPU with boot-CPU fallback, rejects empty isolation, checks first versus second call equality and shared present CPU for noise plus domain, installs masks and records flags. Isolcpus parsing recognizes nohz, domain with boot domain and managed-IRQ prefixes, skips unknown alpha flags, rejects illegal characters and defaults to domain.

Load averages keep an atomic active count, a next-window timestamp and three decayed values. Fixed-point power uses binary exponentiation with rounding; multi-interval decay applies the powered factor. Read index masks the global index to the stable slot. With nohz accounting disabled the drain yields zero and catch-up is a no-op.

Remote membarrier handlers provide a plain barrier, barrier plus deferred core sync, barrier plus rseq refresh with legacy and v2 paths, and runqueue-state sync acting only on matching memory context with barrier ordering. The visible private-expedited prefix takes the current context and picks a default handler before testing sync-core flags.

locks.text: Fair deadline-server pick and single-task detach require the owning or source runqueue lock held; detach scans fair tasks in reverse and accounts a balance event. Blocked-average update takes the target runqueue lock with interrupts saved via a scoped guard and updates the clock first.
Placement needs the task pi lock for stable affinity. Asymmetric list traversal, active domain search, periodic balancing and idle-state lookup run inside RCU read-side sections.

A dedicated mutex serializes fair group share updates. The tickless scan takes each visited runqueue lock with interrupts saved only to advance its clock, releasing before domain balancing. Idle-entry blocked-load marking needs no runqueue lock; check and clear pair with entry ordering.
Expedited membarrier uses one global IPI mutex plus one per-CPU mutex with global and per-CPU guard helpers, initialized for every possible CPU at boot.

Housekeeping masks are published with RCU assignment and read under RCU, with a grace-period wait after replacement or reallocation preserving free-with-generic-allocator semantics. The idle-dequeue diagnostic path drops the interrupt-safe runqueue spinlock around reporting and reacquires before returning.

state_machines.text: Wakeup preemption outcomes are none to keep current, short to ignore slice protection, pick to defer to eligibility, and resched to force rescheduling. Buddy helpers keep an existing next buddy when earlier or shorter, otherwise nominate the wakee.

Group classification has spare, fully busy, misfit, SMT balance, asymmetric packing, affinity imbalance, LLC preference and overload states; LLC balance ranks below overload and above the rest, with failed attempts falling back via the failure counter. Migration reasons are load, utilization, task count, misfit and LLC task; scan scopes are regular, remote and all; LLC permission is forbid, allow-preference or unrestricted.

Tickless kick lifecycle: idle entry sets global blocked and update requests, per-queue work accumulates, the soft interrupt consumes per-queue work, the scanner clears globals then re-arms if work remains or the local CPU gained work mid-scan, and a separate new-balance kick is cleared by the idle loop with stats-only handling when isolated.

Fair membership moves through attach, running selection and detach. Delayed tasks are dequeued before leaving, detachment drops group linkage, attachment restores it with capacity recording, and first selection arms high-resolution tick and tick-stop updates while later selections skip those one-time actions.

Processor idle moves from tickless update and polling setup into a sleeping loop and then to reschedule propagation and scheduling. Each iteration disables interrupts, enters architecture idle, polls when forced or broadcast-expired else uses cpuidle, records tick firing, exits architecture idle and repeats until reschedule is requested.

Idle injection timer marks completion, requests rescheduling and does not restart; the forced-idle path then loops in deep idle until that flag is set. Leaving the idle task refreshes accounting, notifies idle exit and updates average idle; entering updates core tracking, notifies idle entry, counts go-idle, records start from task clock and refreshes idle PELT clock.

Housekeeping runtime update builds a trial domain mask excluding isolated CPUs, rejects empty online intersection, enables the override key on first use, publishes under RCU, waits for readers, flushes PCI, memcg and VM work, then updates unbound workqueues, timer-migration exclusion and kernel threads before freeing the old mask.

Nohz exit syncs the per-runqueue timestamp from the global window, returns early when still before it, and advances the stamp when waking inside the next window to skip double accounting; the read helper drains the stable delta slot when non-zero. Global catch-up folds active count over missed intervals, advances the timestamp, orders the write before flipping the double-buffer index.

Global expedited membarrier returns immediately on a single online CPU, else allocates a mask, serializes with a barrier, IPI mutex and CPU read lock, collects other online CPUs with the global-expedited runqueue flag and a user context, then issues synchronous IPIs with preemption disabled.

structs.text: Load-balance environment carries domain, source and destination CPUs and queues, destination core idle state, group mask, revised destination, idle kind, imbalance, candidate set, flags, loop counters and limits, scan scope, migration reason and task list. Group stats aggregate load, capacity, utilization, runnable time, running counts, idle CPUs, weight, type, packing, SMT and LLC hints, misfit and overutilization; domain stats hold busiest and local groups, totals and both group blocks.

Runqueues expose CPU identity, blocked-load and tick-stopped flags, last blocked-update and next-balance times, per-queue tickless flags, idle-balance type, idle-state pointer, fair queue and task list, and core-scheduling control with force-idle count. Global tickless state holds the idle mask, blocked and needs-update indicators and next balance and blocked deadlines. Entities expose runtime, slice, queue membership, delayed state, group linkage and averaging stamp; fair queues expose weight, queued count and current pointers; cpuidle devices expose residency and latency limit, drivers expose state count.

Idle injection pairs a high-resolution timer with a completion flag. Housekeeping holds an array of RCU-protected CPU-mask pointers indexed by type plus a flags word, with one static instance. Nohz load accounting uses two atomic delta slots plus an integer index whose parity selects the active slot.
